desc:
🚗 Turn cars into CASH!

Welcome to YOUR scrapyard! 

🧲 Drive a real crawler crane with a magnet
🔩 Shred cars into scrap
🧊 Press scrap into valuable cubes
🤝 Serve clients and grow your business
👷 Hire workers to automate your yard
⚡ Upgrade everything: crane speed, magnet power, shredder & more
🔄 Rebirth for permanent boosts
🔓 Reach Rebirth 3 to unlock the next Stage...

📱 Plays great on phone, tablet, console and PC!

⭐ Like the game and join the group for future rewards!
🚀 More cars, machines and secrets coming in updates!
